home.entry_desc: Smart registration interface. Create new orders for factories, specify quantities, product colors, and size distribution in the database.
home.export_desc: Official form generation. Retrieve saved orders and convert them into premium bilingual PDF documents for factory communication.
home.admin_desc: Data center. Add and edit fabrics, colors, factories, currencies, and all dropdown lists that feed the entire system.
home.receiving_desc: Advanced matching interface. Add details of cartons received from factories and mathematically verify quantity matching.
home.factory_portal_desc: Factory owner interface. Record actual manufactured quantities and change delivery status for ready models.
home.barcodes_desc: Generate and manage sequential barcodes for factories and scanners based on colors and sizes.
home.reports_desc: Advanced filtering portal. Extract comprehensive reports by factory, model, or date with Excel and PDF export options.
home.shipping_invoice_desc: Create professional shipping invoices and flexible customized collective reports.
home.packing_list_desc: Generate packing lists for customs with the ability to merge several models into one carton.
home.warehouse_receipt_desc: (Warehouse Receipt) Advanced report for goods receipt from factories, period filtering, and export capabilities.
